description:
Sovara brings your company’s tacit knowledge to your AI agents: the unwritten rules, internal terminology, data conventions, and practical know-how that experienced colleagues rely on.

Work with the right context
Ask your agent to analyze a company, write a query, or investigate a problem. It can retrieve relevant knowledge from Sovara and cite the lessons it uses.

Understand agent behavior
Inspect recorded runs, model and tool calls, and annotations to investigate failures.

Improve knowledge over time
Turn corrections into lesson proposals. Review changes before applying them, with version history and agents that help identify conflicts, duplicates, and outdated guidance.

Sign in with your existing Sovara account, select your organization, and choose which projects the assistant can read or change.

defaultPrompt: Help me write a query for our internal database.
Calculate this company’s adjusted EBITDA using our investment team’s rules.
Propose a lesson from this correction so our agents avoid repeating the mistake.
